session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Lower Low Double Bottom, Bull Channel'. Early lower low and higher low double bottoms at 5662 form a major trend reversal into a grinding bull channel; the midday tests near 5712 make failed head and shoulders attempts and a bull trend trading range, then a late breakout above 5710 closes the day at 5720.
